units.source_text: 他考虑玉鬘的住处：紫姬所居东南区内，没有空着的边屋。

en.t: He considered where Tamakazura should live: in the southeastern quarter where Lady Murasaki resided, there was no vacant side room.

units.source_text: 况且这是繁华的中心，到处住着许多侍女，气象盛大，颇欠幽静。

en.t: Besides, this was the bustling center of the residence, with many serving women living everywhere; it was grand and lively, but lacked quiet seclusion.

units.source_text: 秋好皇后所居西南区内，因皇后不常在家，故经常闲静，给玉鬘这样的人居住，最为适当。

en.t: The southwestern quarter, where Empress Akikonomu lived, was usually peaceful because the Empress was not often at home, and seemed most suitable for someone like Tamakazura.

units.source_text: 然而深恐别人误认玉鬘为侍女，故也不相宜。

en.t: Yet he feared that others might mistake Tamakazura for a serving woman, so that too was unsuitable.

units.source_text: 只有花散里所居东北区内，西厅现为文殿，可将文殿移设他处，让与玉鬘居住。

en.t: Only in the northeastern quarter where Hanachirusato lived, the west hall was currently used as a library; the library could be moved elsewhere and the rooms given to Tamakazura.

units.source_text: 而且花散里性情温和，心地善良，是最好的话伴。

en.t: Moreover, Hanachirusato was gentle in temperament and kind at heart, making her the best possible companion for conversation.

units.source_text: 住处便如此预定了。

en.t: Her residence was thus provisionally decided.

units.source_text: 此时他才把昔年与夕颜结缘之事告知紫姬。

en.t: Only then did he tell Lady Murasaki about his former bond with Yugao.

units.source_text: 紫姬闻知他有此等秘密之事，颇有怨恨之色。

en.t: When Lady Murasaki learned that he had kept such a secret, she looked rather resentful.

units.source_text: 源氏对她说道：“你不须怨恨。

en.t: Genji said to her, "You need not resent me.

units.source_text: 现今生存者的事，我对你也不问自告，何况这个人已经死了。

en.t: Even concerning people still alive today, I tell you without being asked; how much more so when this person has already died.

units.source_text: 每逢此种事情，我总不隐瞒你，正是对你特别重视之故。”

en.t: Whenever such matters arise, I never hide them from you, precisely because I hold you in special regard."

units.source_text: 他慨然回思夕颜当年模样之后，又说道：“此种情况不但我自己有之，在别人也甚多。

en.t: After sadly recalling how Yugao had been in those days, he continued, "Such situations are not mine alone; they are common among others as well.

units.source_text: 有些女子，即使你对她情爱并不甚深，她也非常嫉妒，我所见实例不少。

en.t: Some women become terribly jealous even when one's affection for them is not very deep; I have seen many such examples.

units.source_text: 我很讨厌，常想戒绝色情行为。

en.t: I find it very distasteful and often think of giving up affairs of passion altogether.

units.source_text: 然而不知不觉的，自会遇到许多女子。

en.t: Yet before I know it, I naturally come to meet many women.

units.source_text: 其中娇痴亲昵，一往情深的人，除了这夕颜之外别无其例。

en.t: Among them, no one but Yugao was so endearingly innocent, intimate, and deeply devoted.

units.source_text: 此人如果在世，我总得与西北区的明石姬同等对待她。

en.t: Had she still been alive, I would have had to treat her on equal terms with Lady Akashi in the northwestern quarter.

units.source_text: 容貌与性格，原是十人十色的。

en.t: Looks and character naturally differ from person to person.

units.source_text: 夕颜才气洋溢，而幽雅之趣较差，然而终是个高超可爱之人。”

en.t: Yugao was full of talent, though somewhat lacking in elegant refinement; still, in the end, she was a noble and lovable person."

units.source_text: 紫姬说：“虽然如此，总不能与明石姬同等待遇吧。”

en.t: Lady Murasaki said, "Even so, surely she could not have been treated the same as Lady Akashi."

units.source_text: 可见她对明石姬的过分得宠怀有醋意。

en.t: This showed that she felt jealous of the excessive favor shown to Lady Akashi.

units.source_text: 但她看见娇小玲珑的明石小女公子天真烂漫地倾听他们谈话时的可爱之相，

en.t: But when she saw the small, delicate young Lady Akashi innocently listening to their conversation with such charm,

units.source_text: 又觉得理应宠爱她的生母，醋意尽释了。

en.t: she felt that the child's birth mother naturally deserved to be loved, and her jealousy completely melted away.
